product.title: The GM Challenge — Master the Efficiency Frontier
product.summary: Draft under three real league cap regimes and watch diminishing returns appear.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students draft one player per required position within budget across three real historical datasets in turn — an uncapped league, a hard-capped one, and one with a soft cap and tax — with a live efficiency-frontier chart showing where extra spending stops buying extra production.
product.technology: multi-page static site with Chart.js and real historical player datasets

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Complete and publicly reachable, with a substantial design plan and real historical data. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: GitHub Pages returned 200 on 2026-08-14. Reachability only.

provenance.evidence: 301-M1-L3 spans index.html, activity.html, results.html and completion.html sharing js/storage.js and a league query parameter — recorded as one experience across four screens, not four. Learning objectives name diminishing returns, the efficiency frontier, resource constraints and opportunity cost.
